url.label: CMS URL
url.tooltip: The CMS root, without the /api suffix

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.tooltip: From Administration -> Applications in the CMS. The application must allow the client_credentials grant.

layoutFolder.label: Layout folder
layoutFolder.tooltip: Only offer layouts in this CMS folder and below. Leave empty for every layout in the CMS.

defaultChangeDuration.label: Default duration (seconds)
defaultChangeDuration.tooltip: How long a layout stays before the display returns to its schedule. 0 means it stays until reverted.

inventoryPollInterval.label: Inventory refresh (ms)
inventoryPollInterval.tooltip: How often to re-read display groups and layouts

statusPollInterval.label: Status refresh (ms)
statusPollInterval.tooltip: How often to re-read which displays are online and what they are showing
